run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser: ServiceNow read over cnit and the Scripted REST API as sf.integration, Salesforce read over the sf CLI and anonymous Apex against the deployed classes. Every case reads both sides.

case.title: Snapshot is read-only

steps.text: Record sys_updated_on for every request and task before the call.
Re-read sys_updated_on for every record and compare.

records.label: Records whose sys_updated_on moved across the snapshot call

observations: Naming discrepancy, documentation only: HANDOFF section 5 and this case both describe the payload as carrying sys_updated_on. The resource emits it as `updated_on`. Nothing consumes it today — CafSyncHealth compares status, state and description and never reads the stamp — so the mismatch is latent, and would surface as a silently-null timestamp in whatever reads it first.
expected: Returns number, status, state, description and sys_updated_on for every request and task.
No sys_updated_on anywhere in the scope moves as a result of a snapshot call.
actual: HTTP 200; 19 request(s) and 30 task(s) returned in 712 ms.
Request fields: number, sys_id, caf_status, state, short_description, updated_on
Task fields: number, sys_id, state, approval, met_criteria, short_description, updated_on
0 record(s) changed sys_updated_on across the call.
case.verdictReason: The snapshot returns the documented fields for every record and modifies nothing.
